form_rule: at i=0 use (a,b)=(0,1); at i=1 use (1,0); later compute SHA-256 of ASCII xedni-adaptive-collision-v1| plus comma-separated prior miss bits, use first two 4-byte big-endian words reduced modulo q as (a,b); store aQ+bG
oracle: after each new form, compare with all earlier forms of unequal slope; return one bit for whether any informative equality occurred, then stop on yes
measurement: complete deterministic group-operation and first-hit census; no wall-time performance comparison
